Foreground and tapped pushes now enter the account-filtered SwiftUI store and typed user/note routes without logging payloads; device push E2E and visual gates remain.

The ordinary Messages tab now hosts native SwiftUI history and capability-gated current/legacy adapters; misskey.io currently publishes neither complete DM endpoint family, and authenticated E2E/visual gates remain.
Native conversation navigation, paging, send/retry/cancel, mention/hashtag/URL routing, and keyboard-safe UI are wired; server capability, authenticated E2E, and >=90% visual gates remain.
The ordinary Accounts tab now hosts native SwiftUI add/switch/delete/profile routes; live E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
The ordinary settings route now hosts a native SwiftUI navigation stack; live E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
Native tab reorder/add/delete/name/owner and Light/Dark/accent persistence are wired; live E2E and visual gates remain.
Native instance selection, add/delete/reorder, picker, and compatible persistence are wired; live custom-emoji E2E and visual gates remain.
The ordinary license list and full-text detail are native SwiftUI; visual acceptance remains.
The ordinary About route is native SwiftUI with the recovered gradient, geometry, animation, and links; visual acceptance remains.
No ordinary route uses the orphan account/theme controllers; physical storyboard/source removal is gated on authenticated-root cutover.
Reusable native empty/error/banner presentation is integrated for Accounts/Settings, while remaining legacy surfaces still own the app-wide placeholder contract.
Principal content is SwiftUI behind a required extension host; E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
